important.title: Before work starts:
important.description: Complete RAMS with everyone who will do the work. Record the method of work, who might be harmed and how, and the controls. Then brief the team.

howTo.title: How to complete RAMS

steps.s1: Fill in the date, location, method of work and everyone doing the work
steps.s2: Record anything different today (weather, new people, changes)
steps.s3: For each hazard, say how someone might be harmed and what controls apply
steps.s4: Describe control measures for each hazard
steps.s5: Photograph the work area if it helps
steps.s6: Confirm that everyone understands the RAMS
